observation.visible_scene: A top-down/oblique view of a dark wooden desk surface on which two optical discs (CDs) lie flat, side by side. The left disc shows a warm golden/amber iridescent sheen with a thin dark radial slit running from its center hub toward the lower edge; the right disc shows a brighter silvery-white sheen with greenish reflections near its top. The center hubs are empty (no clamp). Along the top edge of the frame are out-of-focus background items: a pinkish wire object at far left, a row of small boxes/cases in the middle, and a dark rounded object at the right. A few small white specks/debris dots are scattered on the desk (left side and bottom). The scene is evenly lit from above, producing the rainbow reflections on the disc surfaces.
visible_changes: Across all sampled frames (t=0.000 to t=2.669 s) the two discs remain in fixed positions relative to the frame edges and to each other; no translation, rotation, or deformation is observable.
The iridescent reflection patterns on both disc surfaces stay constant in shape and location, indicating the discs are not spinning or tilting.
Background objects and the scattered white specks on the desk do not move.
No person, hand, or tool enters the frame; no contact or placement action occurs within the excerpt.
outside_clip_unknowns: Whether the discs were placed or moved just before t=0.000, or whether any motion occurs after t=2.669, is not shown; this segment captures a static interval only.
The cause of the slit/scratch on the left disc and the purpose of the setup are not visible.
uncertain_details: Any residual camera micro-jitter is below the resolution of these samples, so the shot is best described as effectively static rather than confirmed perfectly motionless.
The exact material/labeling of the discs cannot be determined from the reflective undersides shown.
